_comment: LOCAL DEV DEFAULT. In Docker this file is OVERWRITTEN at container start from public/config.template.json using the instance's environment (see docker-entrypoint.d/20-render-config-json.sh) — edit the template, not this file, for anything deployed. Every endpoint field is intentionally blank: the client then derives host/scheme from the page origin and reads the port from VITE_SERVER_PORT (see .env.example). No IP or port is hardcoded anywhere in the tracked tree.
